about.intro_content: Prof. Hui Han is a Professor in the Department of Urology at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, specialising in genitourinary system cancers including bladder, kidney, prostate, adrenal gland, ureter, urethra, testis, epididymis, spermatic cord and penile cancers.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Han performs approximately 100 partial or radical nephrectomy procedures for kidney cancer, 20 prostatectomy procedures, and 20 cystectomy procedures annually, alongside laparoscopic and open surgical techniques including retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and inguinal lymphadenectomy. He has pursued technical innovations that transformed management of these cancers, including open inguinal lymphadenectomy, laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, and laparoscopic radical prostatectomy. He also has unique expertise managing rare urologic cancers and salvage procedures for recurrent bladder and prostate cancer.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Hui Han

items.question: Does Prof. Hui Han accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to genitourinary cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Han's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Han specialises in genitourinary system cancers, including bladder, kidney, prostate, testicular, penile and other rare urologic cancers.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Han treat cancers that failed initial treatment?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Han has unique expertise in salvage surgical procedures for recurrent bladder and prostate cancer that have failed initial surgery or other treatments.

items.question: Is Prof. Han involved in clinical trials for genitourinary cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Han is Principal Investigator on a trial evaluating neoadjuvant chemotherapy combined with immunotherapy for locally advanced penile cancer.
